scripts.dev:ui: bun run build:web && bun --filter vaultlint dev --ui
scripts.ui: bun run build:web && bun --filter vaultlint ui
scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:web
scripts.test: bun run test:packages && bun run test:cli && bun run test:web
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run e2e
scripts.e2e:site: bun run build:site && bunx playwright test -c playwright.site.config.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint -c oxlint.json apps/cli/src apps/cli/tests apps/web/src packages/*/src e2e e2e-site scripts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write apps/cli/src apps/cli/tests apps/web/src packages/*/src e2e e2e-site scripts playwright.config.ts playwright.site.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check apps/cli/src apps/cli/tests apps/web/src packages/*/src e2e e2e-site scripts playwright.config.ts playwright.site.config.ts
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test

hooks.after:bump: bun install --lockfile-only && bun apps/web/scripts/sync-shell-version.ts && npm --prefix apps/cli version ${version} --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version && bun run build:publish
